en: Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, and accompanied by pleasure, there arises a state that is neither non-demonstrable nor non-reactive and is not accompanied by pleasure, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Six under root; three under object ... pe ... six under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, and not accompanied by pleasure, there arises a state that is neither non-demonstrable nor with-reactive and is not accompanied by pleasure, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
